integrity: The eight-coordinate existence already appears in arXiv:2605.09748; only sharp minimality, full optimizer census, orbit structure, and universal strongly-online selections are claimed as additional results. Full finite evidence is embedded.
scientific_limitations: Binary field, three message coordinates and three concurrent requests only. Counts identify labeled generator-column multisets up to stored-coordinate permutation; 17 classes additionally allow permutation of the named message coordinates, not all GL(3,2) row transformations. A full search covers seven and eight nonzero columns; no independent scientific audit or proof of absolute novelty exists.
title: Sharp length and complete optimizer classification for three-request asynchronous binary batch codes
